title: Benchmark canonical serialization throughput
description:
Add a criterion benchmark that measures canonical_bytes() throughput: serialize 10,000 articles of varying sizes (100B, 1KB, 10KB). Report MB/s. Artifact: crates/core/benches/canonical.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- benchmark runs in under 60 seconds
- reports mean, std, and throughput
- registered in CI bench workflow
